Third-party libraries, bundled so the app makes no requests to other servers.

| File | Library | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `docx.iife.js` | [docx](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx) 9.5.1 | MIT |
| `gifenc.esm.js` | [gifenc](https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc) 1.0.3 | MIT |
| `tesseract/tesseract.min.js`, `tesseract/worker.min.js` | [tesseract.js](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) 5.1.1 | Apache-2.0 |
| `tesseract/tesseract-core-*.wasm.js` | [tesseract.js-core](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core) 5.1.1 | Apache-2.0 |
| `tesseract/eng.traineddata.gz` | [tessdata_best](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best) (English, integer model) | Apache-2.0 |
